title: KV 池化
note_on_kind: 标准代码章（非 primer）：走 implementer 精简版 + lint_fidelity 全链。Part VIII 第三章——ch16 已立 KVConnector 双面契约骨架（F8 埋点）、ch35 已立多实例视角、ch37 已回收 F8 其一（P/D 跨引擎交接：回执信封+租约+握手+READ/WRITE）。本章回收 F8 其二：offload 池化——同一契约把块搬出去再搬回来。主线正典 = vLLM 原生 OffloadingConnector + vllm/v1/kv_offload 池引擎（CPU 主层 + FS/OBJ/P2P 副层 = HBM/DRAM/SSD 分层的内置实现）；生态对照 = MooncakeStore（分布式池）/LMCache/MultiConnector。L0 缩放 = KV 边界+外部池（kv_column+gpu_column：池挂在 ch16 已立的 KV 边界上，池本体在 L0 之外）。Mooncake 论文级架构（KVCache 分层池/转移引擎/master 卟调）由 Research 站先行深挖，本章源码面以 store/ 连接器落点为准。
hook_suggestion: HBM 快而小、DRAM 慢而大、SSD 更慢但巨大——GPU 池里被驱逐的前缀块死一瞬，旁边几百 GB 主存、几 TB 盘闲着：KV 块凭什么不能像 OS 页一样『换出去、要用再换回来』？四道坎：满块刚算完，怎么不打扰 GPU 就搬走？块还在异步搬运、GPU 调度器就要复用它的显存块，谁拦住？SSD 里的块查询命中了却到不了 GPU，请求凭什么『稍后再问』？两台引擎共享一个池时，连『同一前缀』的块哈希都对不上，怎么共享？（从 Part VIII hook『真实服务不止一个引擎』+ 本章主题『KV 池化』+ deepread/memory-kv.json why_chains[9]（offload 需要『把块搬出去再搬回来』的通用通道）+ docs/features/kv_offloading_usage.md 的 DMA 异步/分层设计提炼）
scope_note: 主线 = 一个块进出池的一生（单引擎 kv_role=kv_both + OffloadingConnector 为正典）：(A) 池的构成——双契约嵌套：KVConnectorBase_V1（ch16）之内再嵌 OffloadingSpec 双面契约（OffloadingManager 住调度器进程 / OffloadingWorker 住 worker 进程）；spec 工厂选 CPUOffloadingSpec（单层）或 TieringOffloadingSpec（分层）；(B) CPU 池开张——cpu_bytes_to_use 定容跨 worker 分摊、/dev/shm 共享 mmap（全体 worker+调度器进程同一物理池）、cudaHostRegister 钉页、canonical 张量规范化、chunk 粒度（block_size/blocks_per_chunk）；(C) 存储路径——每步 build_connector_meta 增量采集满块（prompt_only/eagle 尾块/SWA 不可达三重过滤）→prepare_store 准入驱逐（LRU/ARC CachePolicy）→延迟一步提交（避开采样关键路径）→专用 CUDA stream DMA；(D) 查询与加载——get_num_new_matched_tokens 四态查找（None 接 ch16 skipped）→prepare_load ref_cnt 防驱逐→load job DMA 回 GPU→finished_recving 接 ch16 提升路径；(E) 完成回收——completed_jobs 逐 worker 计数、store 不发 finished_sending、jobs_to_flush 围栏（块复用/抢占/终局三触发抢先提交+wait）；(F) 分层池——TieringOffloadingManager 五原则（cascade/网关/promotion/RETRY/ref_cnt），fs/obj/p2p 三种 secondary tier；(G) 跨实例——P2P 层对称 peer 协议（Lookup/Fetch/TransferDone + NIXL WRITE）与 PYTHONHASHSEED 哈希一致前提；(H) 生态对照——MooncakeStore（master 协调的分布式池+SSD 层）、LMCache（外部包/原生双路）、MultiConnector（P/D+池化组合）；(I) 事件面——BlockStored/BlockRemoved 逐块事件让外部索引知道『池里有什么』。边界与邻章分工：契约骨架/WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS/失败回滚/reserved_blocks 护轨归 ch16（本章消费不重讲）；P/D 跨引擎交接/租约心跳/握手归 ch37（本章只对照其 best-effort 差异）；双向 D→P 回拉多轮归 ch39；弹性 KV 迁移归 ch40。可省略分支：canonical_mapping 的 TP 复制页轮转写（CanonicalPageMapping/is_writer/replicated_layout）、XPU/ROCm/Triton 后端择路、obj 层（S3/NIXL OBJ）、Mamba align/eagle 尾块深分支、Mooncake/LMCache 实现内部（生态章以锚点+docs 讲架构不进精简版）。

stations.what: 池的构成与契约再嵌套：OffloadingConnector facade（best-effort：requires_kv_delivery=False，『丢一次 save 只是未来一次 miss』）+ OffloadingSpecFactory 按 spec_name 选引擎（CPUOffloadingSpec 单层 / TieringOffloadingSpec 分层）；OffloadingSpec 自己又是一份双面契约——get_manager 住调度器进程、get_worker 住 worker 进程【F8 回收②】

CPU 池开张：cpu_bytes_to_use ÷ (worker_kv_bytes_per_block×world_size×blocks_per_chunk 按 PAGESIZE 对齐) = num_blocks——跨全部 worker 分摊一份池；worker 侧 /dev/shm/vllm_offload_{engine_id}.mmap 共享 mmap + cudaHostRegister 钉页；任意 attention 布局先规范化成 (num_blocks, page) canonical 张量

入场登记：on_new_request 建 ReqContext（带 kv_transfer_params——per-request 旋钮 max_offload_tokens / kv_load_tiers 层过滤器）+ RequestOffloadState（逐组 offload_keys/block_ids 游标）；tiering 管理器顺访各 secondary 的 policy（BLOCK_LEVEL/REQUEST_LEVEL）

存储路径① 满块采集：每步 build_connector_meta→_build_store_jobs——offload_prompt_only/max_offload_tokens 封顶可卸 token 数；storable_chunks 推进游标（eagle 尾块易变剔除）；『每 chunk 取最后一个 GPU 块』采块；block_id=0（null/陈旧）与 SWA 不可达 chunk 跳过
存储路径② 池准入：prepare_store——已存块过滤（去重）、可逐块不足直接 None 拒收（best-effort：记 ALLOCATION_FAILURE 放弃本批）、CachePolicy(LRU/ARC) 驱逐保护集外块、_allocate_blocks 落位；新块 ref_cnt=-1『写入中』，complete_store 才转 0 可读

存储路径③ 延迟提交：store job 只入 _unsubmitted_store_jobs（get_finished 里 prepare_store_kv 入队），下一步 start_kv_transfers 开头才 submit_store——卸载避开本步 token 采样关键路径（NOTE(orozery) 原话）；wait_for_layer_load/save_kv_layer/wait_for_save 全空实现——ch16 逐层契约的『不逐层』填法

DMA 引擎：SingleDirectionOffloadingHandler 双向各一（store/load）——描述符三缓冲（src ptr/dst ptr/size）+ 专用 CUDA stream 池/事件池；GPU→CPU 先 wait_stream(计算流) 且同向串行（wait_event 前一 transfer）；CPU→GPU 开 SRC_ACCESS_ORDER_ANY（pinned host 不被 GPU 流写）；完成=事件轮询非回调
查询路径：新请求 get_num_new_matched_tokens→_lookup——full 组沿链前缀逐块查（LookupResult 四态：HIT/HIT_PENDING/RETRY/MISS）+SWA 组从尾数连续窗口+多组收敛循环；任一 RETRY→None『稍后再问』接 ch16 skipped 队列；在飞 job 占用或命中块正被加载也 None 延后

加载路径：update_state_after_alloc——命中 keys_to_load→manager.prepare_load（ref_cnt 防驱逐）+ dst GPU 块打 GPULoadStoreSpec（group_sizes/block_indices 支持 offload 块大于 GPU 块的半块对齐）→load job 随 meta 过线→worker submit_load DMA CPU→GPU→finished_recving 接 ch16 提升路径

完成回收与 flush 围栏：completed_jobs {job_id:count} 逐 worker 计数、聚满 world_size 才 complete_store/complete_load；store 永不发 finished_sending（completed_jobs+jobs_to_flush 语义）；GPU 块将被复用/请求被抢占/终局前 store 未完→jobs_to_flush→handle_preemptions 抢先提交+wait 同步围栏——块复用与异步搬运竞态的 best-effort 答案

分层池：TieringOffloadingManager 五原则——CPU primary 是唯一能 DMA GPU 的层；secondary（fs/obj/p2p）只能经 primary 中转：store 完成即 cascade 全层下推、查询命中 secondary 先 promotion（prepare_write 占位→on_schedule_end 批量 submit_load）、期间 RETRY；调度器进程经 primary 的 kv memoryview 直读写 /dev/shm 池

P2P 层：实例间共享 CPU 池——每实例对称 peer（无固定 P/D 角色，同一实例对不同请求可当 consumer 也可当 producer）；kv_transfer_params 三角色键（remote_prefiller/remote_decoder/remote_kv_source）由编排层（router/EPP）驱动 LookupMsg→LookupRespMsg→FetchMsg→NIXL WRITE→TransferDone 协议；PYTHONHASHSEED 强制固定且握手核验

key_classes.name: OffloadingConnector
key_classes.responsibility: 池化正典 facade（L49-L229）：实现 KVConnectorBase_V1+SupportsHMA，按 role 建 OffloadingConnectorScheduler/Worker 半边；best-effort 语义三件——requires_kv_delivery=False（丢 save=未来一次 miss）、request_finished 返回 False（不接管块释放）、wait_for_layer_load/save_kv_layer/wait_for_save 全空（不逐层、不同步等）；get_finished 里顺带 prepare_store_kv 入队 store；get_required_kvcache_layout 强制 HND。

key_classes.name: OffloadingSpec / OffloadingManager / OffloadingWorker
key_classes.responsibility: 第二份双面契约（L162-L186/L220-L394/L545-L566）：spec.get_manager() 产调度器进程的管理器（lookup/prepare_load/touch/complete_load/prepare_store/complete_store——块在哪、谁可逐、ref_cnt 防逐），spec.get_worker(kv_caches) 产 worker 进程的搬运工（submit_store/submit_load/get_finished/wait——显式方向无路由）。与 ch16 KVConnectorBase_V1 同构：决策与搬运分离、两个进程零共享。

key_classes.name: CPUOffloadingSpec / CPUOffloadingManager / CPUOffloadingWorker
key_classes.responsibility: 单层 CPU 池实现。spec 定容（cpu_bytes_to_use→num_blocks，PAGESIZE 对齐，跨 worker 分摊）+ create_worker 建 mmap；manager=块池账本（free list+CachePolicy 驱逐+ref_cnt+事件），lookup 返回四态；worker=双 SingleDirectionOffloadingHandler 的 DMA 组合。

key_classes.name: SingleDirectionOffloadingHandler
key_classes.responsibility: 单向 DMA 引擎（L166-L461）：描述符三缓冲（src/dst 指针+size，池化复用）、CUDA stream/事件池、同向传输串行（stream.wait_event(前一 transfer 的 end_event)）、GPU→CPU 先 wait_stream(计算流)、CPU→GPU 开 SRC_ACCESS_ORDER_ANY；get_finished 按事件 query() 出队（时间戳取 start/end elapsed）。

key_classes.name: SharedOffloadRegion
key_classes.responsibility: /dev/shm/vllm_offload_{engine_id}.mmap 共享区（L28-L188）：全 worker 各占一 slot（按 device index）mmap 整文件、调度器进程 rank=None 也 mmap——一份物理 CPU 池三类执行者（TP workers DMA、secondary tier I/O 线程经 memoryview）；create_next_view 按 canonical 布局切页。

key_classes.name: CachePolicy（lru/arc）+ CachePolicyFactory
key_classes.responsibility: 可插拔驱逐策略：manager 持有 policy（BlockStatus: block_id/ref_cnt/is_ready），evict(n, protected) 只逐空闲块；内置 lru/arc，支持 out-of-tree cache_policy_module_path（fs tier 之外的第二个扩展点）。

key_classes.name: OffloadingConnectorScheduler
key_classes.responsibility: 调度器半边（L445-L1470）：持 manager=OffloadingManager。建档（RequestOffloadState 逐组游标）、四态查询（_lookup 收敛循环）、加载登记（update_state_after_alloc）、每步增量采集 store job（_build_store_jobs）、flush 判定（_block_id_to_pending_jobs 盯块+抢占集合）、完成计数（update_connector_output）、事件翻译（take_events→BlockStored/BlockRemoved）。

key_classes.name: OffloadingConnectorWorker
key_classes.responsibility: worker 半边（L41-L397）：register_kv_caches 把任意布局规范化成 CanonicalKVCaches（packed/cross-layer/逐层三形态）；handle_preemptions 执行 flush（抢先提交+wait）；start_kv_transfers 提交上步 store+本步 load；prepare_store_kv 只入队；get_finished 事件轮询→completed_jobs+finished_recving。

key_classes.name: TieringOffloadingSpec / TieringOffloadingManager / CPUPrimaryTierOffloadingManager

data_flow: 总述：本章数据流 = deepread/memory-kv.json data_flow 的 [调度] connector 段 + [分配] 护轨/ext 段 + [异步 KV] 整段（WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS→worker get_finished→_update_waiting_for_remote_kv→提升回 WAITING/PREEMPTED）外面包一层『每步滚动的存/查/载三循环』——ch16/ch37 已立部分引用不重挖：查询命中→allocate_slots(delay_cache_blocks)→WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS→DMA 加载→finished_recving→_try_promote 补缓存+全命中退一 token。

【开张】facade __init__→build_offloading_config（chunk 粒度/事件/并行参数打包）→OffloadingSpecFactory.create_spec；SCHEDULER 半边 get_manager 建块池账本（Tiering 时调度器进程也 mmap /dev/shm 池），WORKER 半边 register_kv_caches 规范化张量→get_worker 建 DMA handler（worker mmap 同一池+cudaHostRegister 钉页）。

【存·每步】schedule 尾 build_connector_meta：_update_req_states 吃 scheduler_output 增量块号→on_schedule_end（tiering 批提交 promotion）→_build_store_jobs 对每个本步有产出的请求推进 next_stored_chunk_idx 采集新满块 keys+src GPU 块→manager.prepare_store（驱逐/拒收/落位，ref_cnt=-1）→store_jobs 进 meta；同帧收集 jobs_to_flush（块将被复用/请求被抢占）。

【存·worker】meta 过线→execute_model 收尾 get_finished：prepare_store_kv 把 store_jobs 入 _unsubmitted_store_jobs（延迟一步）→（无 token 步也走到这——ch16 kv_connector_no_forward）→下一步 start_kv_transfers 开头 submit_store：描述符组装（sub-block 指针+半块 skip）→专用 stream DMA GPU→CPU（先 wait_stream 计算流）→事件入队。

【查】新请求 waiting 循环（ch16 站3 双查）：get_num_new_matched_tokens→_lookup 逐块 manager.lookup（CPU 命中即 HIT；tiering 时 secondary 命中即 promotion 发起、RETRY）→None 进 skipped 下步再问；命中数→allocate_slots(num_external, delay)（ch16 站5-6 原样复用）。

【载】update_state_after_alloc：命中 keys→prepare_load（ref_cnt+1 防逐）→dst GPU 块 GPULoadStoreSpec→load job 进 meta→worker start_kv_transfers submit_load：CPU→GPU DMA（SRC_ACCESS_ORDER_ANY 流水线源读）→WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS 等待（ch16 站6）。

【收】worker get_finished 事件轮询：load 完成报 finished_recving→调度器 _update_from_kv_xfer_finished→_try_promote→_update_waiting_for_remote_kv（ch16 站9 提升）；store 完成只 mark_completed(job_id)→completed_jobs 回传→update_connector_output 计数聚满 world_size→complete_store（ref_cnt=-1→0，块变可查可逐）/complete_load（解钉）。

【围栏】块复用/抢占/终局三触发 jobs_to_flush：调度器 _block_id_to_pending_jobs 盯『已被 store 引用但未完成』的块，当本步新分配块与之相交→flush 集合→worker handle_preemptions（execute_model 入口，_update_states 之前）把对应 store 抢先提交并 wait() 同步——保证 GPU 改写块之前搬运已完成。

【分层】tiering：complete_store 后 cascade 到全部 secondary（primary.prepare_read 钉 ref_cnt→tier.submit_store）；查询 secondary 命中→_initiate_promotion（primary.prepare_write 占位 ref_cnt=-1）→on_schedule_end 批量 submit_load（secondary→primary）→完成 complete_write 转可读→下次查询 HIT→再走【载】。
【生态】MooncakeStore：查询走 worker 进程的 ZMQ RPC（lookup_async 后台线程），存/载 I/O 全在 get_finished 里发（compute 后重叠）；MultiConnector：按 connectors 列表顺序第一个命中数>0 者加载（后续更长不覆盖）、全子收存——P/D 与池化并存。

why_chains.card: deepread/memory-kv.json why_chains[9]（本章为其第二回收章：ch16 立契约、ch37 填 P/D 传输后端、本章填 offload 池化后端）
why_chains.decision: KVConnector 双面契约：把外部 KV 世界（P/D 分离、CPU/NVMe offload）接到同一个池
why_chains.old_design: KV 困在单引擎进程的 GPU 池里；P/D 早期靠定制传输（v0 kv_transfer 基本只有 NIXL 一条路）；offloading 与 P/D 各写各的，无法组合；混合模型+connector 的多组语义（每组的块表/命中长度都不同）曾直接不支持。
why_chains.pain: prefill 算力密集、decode 带宽密集，同卡混跑互相拖累；decode 实例拿不到 prompt KV 无法开工；offload 需要「把块搬出去再搬回来」的通用通道；每个传输后端各写一套调度钩子 = 不可组合。
why_chains.solution: KVConnectorBase_V1 把契约劈成两半（vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/base.py:L7-L41 docstring 逐条列原语）。调度器侧（scheduler 进程）：get_num_new_matched_tokens 把外部缓存当第二个前缀缓存查（vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py:L769-L789；返回 None=「稍后再问」，请求进 skipped 队列 L783-L789）、update_state_after_alloc（L1000-L1005）、request_finished 返回 True 即接管块的异步释放（base.py:L559-L577；混合模型走 SupportsHMA.request_finished_all_groups，base.py:L93-L114；调度器侧实例还可用 bind_gpu_block_pool 直读块池元数据，vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py:L291-L294）。worker 侧（每个 worker 进程）：start_load_kv/wait_for_layer_load 逐层异步加载与计算重叠（base.py:L305-L334）、save_kv_layer/wait_for_save（L337-L367；wait_for_save 的存在理由原话「This prevents overwrites of paged KV buffer before saving done」）、handle_preemptions（L297-L302，OffloadingConnector 在块被覆写前抢救）。异步加载路径：请求先占块但延迟入缓存（allocate_slots 的 delay_cache_blocks，kv_cache_manager.py:L549-L552 注释「P/D: delay caching blocks if we have to recv from remote」），状态置 WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS 停在 skipped 队列（vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py:L1023-L1053，num_computed_tokens 先行设置但闲置）；传输完成后 _update_waiting_for_remote_kv 补缓存并对全命中回退一个 token 重算（L2635-L2676）。加载失败的块按第一个坏块截断 num_computed_tokens 并对截断后重算区补登记清零（L2643-L2663 + kv_cache_manager.py:L817-L829 record_blocks_for_zeroing；_update_requests_with_invalid_blocks L2743 起）。异步准入护轨：async load 请求须 fits in (free − 其余在途 prefill 的预约)（reserved_blocks，vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py:L965-L971 + _request_remaining_blocks L2614-L2626 + _inflight_prefill_reserved_blocks L2628-L2633），防死锁与可预期抢占。数据所有权转移点三处：异步加载期「已分配未缓存」；请求结束且 request_finished→True 时块不释放直到 get_finished 报完成（_update_from_kv_xfer_finished，vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py:L2714-L2741 + _free_request L2300-L2327）；异步调度+consumer 场景 free 整体延迟到在途步处理完（defer_block_free L150-L156 + _free_request_blocks L2341-L2354 带 sched_step_seq 栅栏）。本章视角的增量：契约在池化场景的填法与 P/D 全面对照——不逐层（wait_for_layer_load/save_kv_layer 空实现）、不同步（wait_for_save 空实现，围栏改走 jobs_to_flush）、不接管（request_finished 返回 False）、best-effort（requires_kv_delivery=False，offloading_connector.py:L55-L58 注释原话「a dropped save is just a future cache miss」）；且契约内部又嵌一份同构双面契约（OffloadingSpec 的 Manager/Worker 两半，kv_offload/base.py:L162-L186+L545-L566）——『决策在调度器进程、搬运在 worker 进程』的模式递归了一层。
why_chains.cost: ① 双查找路径：本地前缀缓存与 connector 缓存都要查再手工合并（含子块尾仲裁 L791-L811、混合 per-group 发散回退 L813-L821 两处补丁性逻辑）；② 异步加载期占着池块却不产生前向进度（容量空转窗口），还要靠预约护轨防它挤死在途 prefill；③ wait_for_save 是强制同步点（P/D 场景）；④ 调度器侧/worker 侧必须分开构建、不许共享状态（factory 双角色）——本章还多一层：池化把 CPU 池本体放在 /dev/shm 让两进程真共享数据但零共享状态；⑤ invalid-block 回滚链路（截断+去重+重登记清零）复杂且正确性敏感（本章 MooncakeStore 走 get_block_ids_with_load_errors 同款回收）；⑥ requires_kv_delivery 的 producer 在 hand-off 未决时抢占要 drop_stale_output（vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py:L617-L621、base.py:L184-L194）——offload 明确退出此语义。

why_chains.card: 本章现核（offloading_connector.py + offloading/scheduler.py + offloading/worker.py 源码）
why_chains.decision: best-effort 池：丢一次 save 只是未来一次 miss——不接管块释放、不强制同步、被复用时才抢救
why_chains.old_design: ch37 P/D 的可靠交接语义：producer request_finished→True 接管块、租约钉住 30s 等心跳续租、交接未决被抢占要 drop_stale_output、requires_kv_delivery 默认 producer=True——每个块都必须可靠送达对端。
why_chains.pain: offload 的 store 每步都在发生（满块算出来就搬）：若也按可靠语义设计，每个 store 都得延迟释放 GPU 块等确认——GPU 池容量被 CPU/SSD 的搬运节奏绑架；而池化丢一块的代价只是『下次查询 miss、重算一遍』，与正确性无关。
why_chains.solution: 三件套（offloading_connector.py）：① requires_kv_delivery=False（L55-L58 注释原话「Runs as kv_both, but is a best-effort cache: a dropped save is just a future cache miss, so opt out of the producer-role default」）；② request_finished 返回 False、不 delay_free（offloading/scheduler.py:L1375-L1414——只登记 non_sliding_window_block_ids 供 flush 盯防）；③ 正确性围栏换成 jobs_to_flush：调度器 _block_id_to_pending_jobs 盯住『store 引用中』的 GPU 块，当 KV cache manager 本步要重新分配这些块（offloading/scheduler.py:L1237-L1249）或请求被抢占（L1229-L1235）或终局（L1209-L1214）→ 收进 jobs_to_flush → worker handle_preemptions（execute_model 入口、_update_states 之前，ch16 m7 挂点）把对应 store 从延迟队列抢先提交并 worker.wait() 同步（offloading/worker.py:L292-L317）——GPU 改写块之前搬运必已完成。
why_chains.cost: ① store 与块复用之间始终存在窗口期，靠 flush 围栏兜底——围栏是同步 wait，最坏把一步停顿到 DMA 完成；② 丢 store/拒收（驱逐空间不足 prepare_store 返 None）静默降级命中率（仅记 ALLOCATION_FAILURE 指标，offloading/scheduler.py:L1104-L1109）；③ 双语义并存增加认知税：同一 KVConnectorBase_V1 契约下 P/D=可靠、池化=best-effort，读者必须看 requires_kv_delivery 才知道自己在哪个世界。

why_chains.card: 本章现核（kv_offload/tiering/manager.py docstring L4-L21 + spec.py + fs/p2p 各层源码 + docs/features/kv_offloading_usage.md:L8-L23）
why_chains.decision: 分层池：CPU 主层是唯一能碰 GPU 的层，secondary 全部经它中转（cascade 下推 / promotion 升回）
why_chains.old_design: 两级世界（GPU↔CPU）DMA 直连即可；想再挂 SSD/对象存储/远端实例——这些介质都没有 DMA GPU 显存的能力，若各自直连 GPU 各写一套搬运，又是不可组合的老路。
why_chains.pain: HBM 几十 GB、DRAM 几百 GB、SSD 几 TB——容量阶梯三个量级、带宽/延迟阶梯也是三个量级：谁住哪、怎么升降、查询怎么统一？secondary 的 I/O（文件线程/网络）发生在哪一层、哪个进程？
why_chains.solution: TieringOffloadingManager 五原则（manager.py:L4-L21 docstring 逐条）：① Always offload to all tiers——store 完成即 cascade 到全部 secondary（complete_store L586-L630：primary.prepare_read 钉 ref_cnt→tier.submit_store）；② Primary tier is the gateway——secondary 不能碰 GPU，一切经 CPU 主层；③ Staged promotion——secondary 命中先升回主层（lookup L282-L350：_initiate_promotion 占位 prepare_write ref_cnt=-1→RETRY）再用；④ Transparent retry——RETRY/None 语义让请求『稍后再问』（接 ch16 skipped 队列）；⑤ ref_cnt as eviction protection。secondary 的 I/O 在调度器进程：spec.get_manager 时调度器进程也 mmap 同一 /dev/shm 区（tiering/spec.py:L170-L215 rank=None），secondary 拿 primary.get_kv_memoryview() 直接读写池——GPU↔CPU DMA 在 worker 进程、CPU↔secondary I/O 在调度器进程，同一物理池两个进程各管一段搬运。
why_chains.cost: ① secondary 数据必两跳（secondary→CPU→GPU），promotion 延迟=两段搬运+至少一次 RETRY 往返（请求晚一至多步才命中）；② 主层满则 promotion 直接失败（lookup 返回 MISS——『有数据也到不了 GPU』）；③ cascade 全层下推=写放大（每块写进每个 secondary，fs 磁盘寿命/obj 流量）；④ store_threshold 频次过滤在分层模式被禁（spec.py:L220-L222 显式 raise——cascade 语义要求全块上下文，见 OffloadPolicy.REQUEST_LEVEL）。

why_chains.card: 本章现核（offloading/worker.py:L332-L344 NOTE(orozery) + offloading_connector.py:L120-L134 + mooncake/store/worker.py:L1538-L1562）
why_chains.decision: store 延迟一步提交：卸载避开本步 token 采样的关键路径
why_chains.old_design: 在 forward 收尾的 wait_for_save 里同步发起/等待保存（v0.21 的 OffloadingConnector 曾把 prepare_store 放在 wait_for_save 路径）——若再同步等 CPU/磁盘写完，每步都白加一段 I/O 延迟。
why_chains.pain: offload 是旁路缓存：它的搬运不该出现在『采出下一个 token』的关键路径上——decode 每步几十 ms，SSD 写一个 chunk 可能就要 ms 级。
why_chains.solution: worker.prepare_store_kv 在 get_finished 里只把 store job 入 _unsubmitted_store_jobs（NOTE(orozery) 原话「defer the store to the beginning of the next engine step, so that offloading starts AFTER transfers related to token sampling, thereby avoiding delays to token generation」，worker.py:L338-L344）；真正提交在下一步 start_kv_transfers 开头（L319-L324）——且 get_finished 在无 token 步也会被走到（ch16 kv_connector_no_forward），store 永不遗漏（offloading_connector.py:L120-L123 wait_for_save 空实现的注释「Store deferral is handled in get_finished(), which always runs」）。生态同型：MooncakeStoreWorker 的 start_load_kv/wait_for_save 双 no-op、I/O 全在 get_finished 发（store/worker.py:L1538-L1562 docstring「All load and store I/O requests are issued here (after model compute is launched on the compute stream) for better compute-I/O overlap」）。
why_chains.cost: ① 块多一步的暴露窗口：入队到提交之间 GPU 块可能被复用——靠 jobs_to_flush 围栏（WC2）兜；② 单请求单方向互斥：load 期间不收 store（scheduler.py transfer_jobs 不变量「at any given time this contains either a single load job, or one or more store jobs」，L283-L285）；③ 调试复杂度：『哪一步提交』与『哪一步产生』错位一格，读 trace 时要对齐。

why_chains.decision: DMA 引擎三戒：store 等计算流、同向保序、load 才许乱序源读
why_chains.old_design: 朴素做法两条：同步拷贝（torch tensor copy 阻塞主线程）或无脑全异步（与计算流并发读写同一块 GPU KV）。
why_chains.pain: store 读的是活数据：计算流还在写本步 KV，异步 DMA 若抢跑，搬到 CPU 的是半新半旧的块；而 CPU 池页是 pinned 且永远没有 GPU 流在写它——两类源的安全性完全不对称。
why_chains.solution: SingleDirectionOffloadingHandler 的三条顺序规则（gpu_worker.py:L362-L400）：① GPU→CPU：transfer stream 先 wait_stream(current_stream)——等模型计算写完再搬；② 同向保序：每个新 transfer 的 stream wait_event(前一 transfer 的 end_event)——同方向串行执行（注释「assure job will start only after the previous one completes」），流/事件/描述符缓冲全池化复用；③ CPU→GPU：is_src_access_order_any=True 开 CU_MEMCPY_SRC_ACCESS_ORDER_ANY 让驱动流水线源读——安全性论证在注释原文（L384-L389「CPU->GPU reads from host pinned memory, which is never written by a concurrent GPU stream … GPU->CPU reads from the live GPU KV cache, which the compute stream keeps writing; we must keep STREAM ordering」）；kernel 选择上 GPU→CPU 恒用专用拷贝引擎 ops.swap_blocks_batch（L40-L42「GPU->CPU is bandwidth-bound; the dedicated copy engine beats Triton」），CPU→GPU 小页才可能走 Triton swap_blocks_batch。
why_chains.cost: ① 同向串行=带宽利用上限单流，大批量 store 排队（有 events 计时可观测）；② wait_stream(计算流) 让 store 晚于本步全部计算——延迟一步提交（WC4）正好把它推进下一拍窗口；③ 平台分叉：XPU 无统一虚拟地址、ROCm host mapping 下 Triton 路径回退 C++ DMA（L43-L47），教学版只需一条路径。

why_chains.old_design: 单进程前缀缓存：块哈希的链式种子 NONE_HASH 用 os.urandom(32) 随机生成（头部注释块 kv_cache_utils.py:L89「We use a random value to avoid hash collisions」；随机生成代码行在 L111-L112）——进程内自洽即可，没人关心第二个进程的哈希值。

why_chains.cost: ① 部署税：每个共享实例都要显式设同一个环境变量（忘了=p2p 直接拒启、fs/obj 静默 miss）；② 固定种子理论上增加碰撞面（工程上 SHA-256/xxhash 碰撞概率可忽略）；③ digest 含 block_size/并行/dtype——任何漂移=新目录孤立旧数据（无害但占盘）。

        **kwargs,
    ) -> None:
        pass

    def wait_for_save(self):
        # Store deferral is handled in get_finished(), which always runs even
        # when wait_for_save() is skipped (e.g. kv_connector_no_forward).
        pass

    def get_finished(self, finished_req_ids: set[str]) -> tuple[set[str], set[str]]:
        assert self.connector_worker is not None
        assert isinstance(self._connector_metadata, OffloadingConnectorMetadata)

        # Defer store jobs to the next step's start_kv_transfers. Done here

class LookupResult(Enum):
    """Result of OffloadingManager.lookup()."""

    MISS = auto()
    HIT = auto()
    HIT_PENDING = auto()
    RETRY = auto()


class OffloadPolicy(Enum):
    # Offload only newly-computed blocks as they arrive; prefix-hit
    # blocks (already offloaded by a prior request) are skipped.
    BLOCK_LEVEL = "block_level"
    # Offload all blocks for the request, including prefix hits.
    # Used by tiers that need the complete KV context for a request.
    REQUEST_LEVEL = "request_level"


@dataclass
class RequestOffloadingContext:
    policy: OffloadPolicy = OffloadPolicy.BLOCK_LEVEL

"""
OffloadingManager class for managing KV data offloading in vLLM v1

This class runs in the scheduler, tracks which blocks are offloaded
and their address.

The class provides the following primitives:
    lookup() - check whether a single block is offloaded and ready.
    prepare_load() - prepare given blocks to be read.
        The given blocks will be protected from eviction.
        This function returns a LoadSpec which encapsulates
        information required for performing the load.
    touch() - marks the give blocks as recently used. Can be used
        to track block's LRU. This function is separated from the
        prepare_load function to allow setting block recency even
        for blocks which do not need reading from the cache, such as
        blocks that are cached by the GPU prefix cache.
    complete_load() - mark blocks which were previously prepared to be
        loaded as done loading. This is to re-allow their eviction.
    prepare_store() - prepare the given blocks to be written.
        Returns a StoreSpec encapsulating offloading information,
        as well as a list of blocks that were evicted as a result.
    complete_store() - marks a previous store as completed.
        Following this call, the given blocks will become loadable.
"""

def __init__(self, config: OffloadingConfig):
        super().__init__(config)

        cpu_bytes_to_use = self.extra_config.get("cpu_bytes_to_use")
        if not cpu_bytes_to_use:
            raise Exception(
                "cpu_bytes_to_use must be specified in kv_connector_extra_config"
            )

        world_size = config.parallel.world_size
        self.num_blocks = 0
        self.kv_bytes_per_chunk = 0
        self.cpu_page_size_per_worker = 0
        self.replicated_layout = config.replicated_layout and self._uses_shared_region()
        if config.worker_kv_bytes_per_block > 0 and world_size > 0:
            num_copies = 1 if self.replicated_layout else world_size
            kv_bytes_per_block = config.worker_kv_bytes_per_block * num_copies
            kv_bytes_per_chunk = kv_bytes_per_block * self.blocks_per_chunk

            # calculate cpu_page_size_per_worker
            self.cpu_page_size_per_worker = kv_bytes_per_chunk // num_copies

            # calculate num_blocks
            aligned_kv_bytes_per_chunk = round_up(
                kv_bytes_per_chunk, self.BLOCK_SIZE_ALIGNMENT
            )
            self.num_blocks = int(cpu_bytes_to_use) // aligned_kv_bytes_per_chunk

            # Expose aligned_kv_bytes_per_chunk as
            # kv_bytes_per_chunk. Note that this might contain
            # some padding. i.e. each offloaded block is of the form,
            # |--- W0-B0---|---- W1-B0---| ... |---- Wn-B0---| *** maybe-pad *** |
            # or |--- B0 (single copy) ---| *** maybe-pad *** |
            self.kv_bytes_per_chunk = aligned_kv_bytes_per_chunk

def get_num_new_matched_tokens(
        self, request: Request, num_computed_tokens: int
    ) -> tuple[int | None, bool]:
        """
        Get number of new tokens that can be loaded beyond the
        num_computed_tokens.

        Args:
            request (Request): the request object.
            num_computed_tokens (int): the number of locally
                computed tokens for this request

        Returns:
            A tuple with the following elements:
                - The number of tokens that can be loaded beyond what is
                  already computed.
                  If None, it means that the connector needs more time to
                  determine the number of matched tokens, and the scheduler
                  should query for this request again later.
                - `True` if tokens will be loaded asynchronously
                  (between scheduler steps).
        """
        req_status = self._req_status[request.request_id]
        for group_state in req_status.group_states:
            group_state.block_ids.clear()

        if req_status.transfer_jobs:
            logger.debug(
                "Delaying request %s since it still has in-flight transfers",
                request.request_id,
            )
            return None, False

        req_status.update_offload_keys()
        req_status.num_locally_computed_tokens = num_computed_tokens

        num_hit_tokens: int | None
        if request.skip_reading_prefix_cache:
            num_hit_tokens = 0
        else:
            lookup_start = time.monotonic()
            num_hit_tokens = self._lookup(req_status)
            self._connector_stats.observe_histogram(
                _ConnectorMetricName.LOOKUP_SYNC_DELAY,
                time.monotonic() - lookup_start,
            )
            if num_hit_tokens is None:
                if req_status.deferred_lookup_start_time is None:
                    req_status.deferred_lookup_start_time = lookup_start
            else:
                self._maybe_observe_lookup_async_delay(req_status)
        req_status.update_num_hit_chunks(num_computed_tokens + (num_hit_tokens or 0))

        self._touch(req_status)

        return num_hit_tokens, bool(num_hit_tokens)

def _maximal_prefix_lookup(
        self,
        keys: Iterable[OffloadKey],
        req_context: ReqContext,
        req: Request,
        group_config: GroupOffloadConfig,
        start_chunk_idx: int,
    ) -> int | None:
        """Return the number of consecutive offloaded chunks from the start,
        or None if the backend deferred a lookup."""
        hit_count = 0
        defer_lookup = False
        for local_idx, key in enumerate(keys):
            result = self.manager.lookup(key, req_context)
            match result:
                case LookupResult.HIT:
                    self._events_tracker.record_lookup(
                        req,
                        group_config,
                        start_chunk_idx + local_idx,
                        key,
                    )
                    hit_count += 1
                case LookupResult.HIT_PENDING:
                    defer_lookup = True
                    hit_count += 1
                case LookupResult.RETRY:
                    # Don't break: keep scanning to let manager kick off
                    # async lookups (until a miss is detected).
                    defer_lookup = True
                case LookupResult.MISS:
                    break
        return hit_count if not defer_lookup else None

@override
    def prepare_store(
        self,
        keys: Collection[OffloadKey],
        req_context: ReqContext,
    ) -> PrepareStoreOutput | None:
        if self.counts is not None:
            num_keys = len(keys)
            keys = [k for k in keys if self.counts.get(k, 0) >= self.store_threshold]
            self.stores_skipped_in_current_batch += num_keys - len(keys)
        # filter out blocks that are already stored
        keys_to_store = [k for k in keys if self._policy.get(k) is None]

        if not keys_to_store:
            return PrepareStoreOutput(
                keys_to_store=[],
                store_spec=self._get_load_store_spec([], []),
                evicted_keys=[],
            )

        self.allocation_sizes_in_current_batch.append(len(keys_to_store))
        num_blocks_to_evict = len(keys_to_store) - self._get_num_free_blocks()

        to_evict: list[OffloadKey] = []
        if num_blocks_to_evict > 0:
            if num_blocks_to_evict > self._num_evictable_cache_blocks:
                # Eviction will fail.
                return None
            # There is a still a chance for eviction failure as some of the
            # idle blocks might be in the protected list.

            # Blocks from the original input are excluded from eviction candidates:
            # a block that was already stored must remain in the cache after this call.
            protected = set(keys)
            evicted = self._policy.evict(num_blocks_to_evict, protected)
            if evicted is None:
                return None

            # cache-policy removes only idle blocks.
            self._num_evictable_cache_blocks -= len(evicted)
            assert self._num_evictable_cache_blocks >= 0

            for key, block in evicted:
                self._free_block(block)
                to_evict.append(key)

        if to_evict and self.events is not None:
            self.events.append(
                OffloadingEvent(
                    keys=to_evict,
                    medium=self.medium,
                    removed=True,
                )
            )

        blocks = self._allocate_blocks(keys_to_store)
        assert len(blocks) == len(keys_to_store), (
            "Block pool did not allocate the expected number of blocks"
        )

        for key, block in zip(keys_to_store, blocks):
            self._policy.insert(key, block)
        self._num_write_pending_blocks += len(keys_to_store)

        # build store specs for allocated blocks
        store_spec = self._get_load_store_spec(keys_to_store, blocks)

        return PrepareStoreOutput(
            keys_to_store=keys_to_store,
            store_spec=store_spec,
            evicted_keys=to_evict,
        )

def start_kv_transfers(self, metadata: OffloadingConnectorMetadata):
        assert self.worker is not None
        for job_id, src_spec, dst_spec in self._unsubmitted_store_jobs:
            success = self.worker.submit_store(job_id, src_spec, dst_spec)
            assert success
        self._unsubmitted_store_jobs.clear()

        for job_id, entry in metadata.load_jobs.items():

def get_finished(self, finished_req_ids: set[str]) -> tuple[set[str], set[str]]:
        """
        Returns:
            tuple of (finished_sending, finished_recving). Stores never
            emit finished_sending — the scheduler tracks store completion
            via kv_connector_worker_meta.completed_jobs and fences any
            block reuse via jobs_to_flush. Loads still emit
            finished_recving so the base scheduler can resume requests
            blocked on remote KV (and free aborted-during-load reqs).
        """
        assert self.worker is not None
        finished_recving: set[str] = set()
        for transfer_result in self.worker.get_finished():
            # we currently do not support job failures
            job_id = transfer_result.job_id
            assert transfer_result.success
            is_load = job_id in self._load_jobs
            if (
                transfer_result.transfer_time is not None
                and transfer_result.transfer_size is not None
            ):
                if is_load:
                    stats = self._connector_worker_meta.transfer_stats.load
                else:
                    stats = self._connector_worker_meta.transfer_stats.store
                stats.record(
                    transfer_result.transfer_size,
                    transfer_result.transfer_time,
                )

            self._connector_worker_meta.mark_completed(job_id)
            req_id = self._load_jobs.pop(job_id, None)
            if req_id is not None:
                finished_recving.add(req_id)

        return set(), finished_recving

@override
    def complete_store(
        self,
        keys: Collection[OffloadKey],
        req_context: ReqContext,
        success: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Mark blocks as done storing from GPU to primary tier.

        This is where secondary tier cascading happens — after blocks are
        confirmed to be in the primary tier, they are cascaded to ALL
        secondary tiers.

        For each secondary tier:
        1. Call primary.prepare_read() to get LoadStoreSpec AND increment
           ref_cnt (protecting blocks during async transfer)
        2. Call tier.submit_store() to start async transfer: primary→secondary
        3. Track the job in _store_jobs dictionary

        Args:
            keys: Blocks that finished storing.
            success: Whether the GPU→primary transfer succeeded.
            req_context: Per-request context forwarded to primary.prepare_read().
        """
        # Step 1: Complete store in primary tier (makes blocks loadable)
        self.primary_tier.complete_store(keys, req_context, success)

        if success:
            # Step 2: Cascade to ALL secondary tiers
            # For each secondary tier, call primary.prepare_read() to get the
            # LoadStoreSpec AND to increment ref_cnt (protecting blocks from
            # eviction during the async transfer). One prepare_read() call per
            # secondary tier.
            for tier in self.secondary_tiers:
                job_metadata = self.create_store_job(keys, req_context)
                tier.submit_store(job_metadata)

        # Note: The async transfers are now in flight. Their completion is
        # tracked via get_finished_jobs() / _maybe_process_finished_jobs().
        req_id = req_context.req_id
        state = self._req_state[req_id]
        assert state.pending_primary_stores > 0
        state.pending_primary_stores -= 1
        self._maybe_finalize_request(req_id)

def get_num_new_matched_tokens(
        self,
        request: Request,
        num_computed_tokens: int,
    ) -> tuple[int | None, bool]:
        """Check for external KV cache hit.

        Returns ``(None, False)`` when an async lookup is still in flight,
        signaling the scheduler to retry this request on a later step.
        """
        if not self.enable_lookup:
            return 0, False

        # Fine-grained hits may land on a hash boundary inside a block; without
        # partial hits, prefixes shorter than one physical block are skipped.
        align = (
            self._hash_block_size if self.enable_partial_hash_hits else self._block_size
        )
        if request.num_tokens < align:
            return 0, False

        num_external_hit_tokens = self.client.lookup(
            request.request_id,
            request.num_tokens,
            request.block_hashes,
            non_block=self.lookup_async,
        )
        if num_external_hit_tokens is None:
            # Lookup not ready yet; scheduler will retry on a later step.
            return None, False

        if num_external_hit_tokens < num_computed_tokens:
            need_to_allocate = 0
        else:
            need_to_allocate = num_external_hit_tokens - num_computed_tokens

        logger.debug(
            "Reqid: %s, Total tokens %d, kvpool hit tokens: %d, need to load: %d",
            request.request_id,
            request.num_tokens,
            num_external_hit_tokens,
            need_to_allocate,
        )

        if need_to_allocate <= 0:
            return 0, False

        self.load_specs[request.request_id] = LoadSpec(
            vllm_cached_tokens=num_computed_tokens,
            kvpool_cached_tokens=num_external_hit_tokens,
            can_load=False,
        )

        return need_to_allocate, self.load_async

# The hash seed for the first block of any prefix block sequence.
#
# We use a random value to avoid hash collisions or PYTHONHASHSEED environment
# variable if set such that processes can share the seed if needed. This aligns
# with the behavior of Python's hash() function, which also uses a random seed
# if PYTHONHASHSEED is not set.
#
# The function `init_none_hash` initializes this variable globally.
NONE_HASH: BlockHash
_CBOR_HASH_FUNCTIONS = frozenset({sha256_cbor, xxhash_cbor})


def init_none_hash(hash_fn: Callable[[Any], bytes]):
    global NONE_HASH

    hash_seed = os.getenv("PYTHONHASHSEED")
    if hash_seed is None and hash_fn in _CBOR_HASH_FUNCTIONS:
        logger.warning(
            "PYTHONHASHSEED is not set. This will lead to non-reproducible "
            "block-hashes when using CBOR-based hash functions such as "
            "sha256_cbor or xxhash_cbor. Consider setting PYTHONHASHSEED to a "
            "fixed value for reproducibility."
        )

    if hash_seed is None:
        NONE_HASH = BlockHash(os.urandom(32))
    else:
        NONE_HASH = BlockHash(hash_fn(hash_seed))

theory: 存储阶梯账（HBM/DRAM/SSD 分层的 why）：容量 ~数十 GB / 数百 GB / 数 TB（三个量级），带宽 ~TB/s 级（HBM3e 4-8TB/s）/ 数十-百 GB/s（DDR5 双通道 ~100GB/s 级、多路可堆）/ 数 GB/s（NVMe）——延迟 ~百 ns / ~百 ns-μs / ~十 μs。池化的期望收益 = 命中率 ×（重算成本 − 回载成本）：一块 GPU 前缀命中省的是整段 prefill 注意力 FLOPs，代价是一次 DMA/读盘带宽——算力/带宽价差就是套利空间；官方口径『a bigger CPU tier means fewer trips to slower secondary tiers』且单层时『cpu_bytes_to_use 应大于 GPU 池总量，否则只是镜像 GPU 已有的内容』（kv_offloading_usage.md:L275-L279）。

CPU 池定价公式（spec.py 逐字算式）：num_blocks = cpu_bytes_to_use // round_up(worker_kv_bytes_per_block × world_size × blocks_per_chunk, PAGESIZE)——预算是全 worker 总量而非 per-worker；布局 |--- W0-B0 ---|--- W1-B0 ---|…| maybe-pad |（注释原文），每 worker 的 cpu_page_size = kv_bytes_per_chunk // num_copies。store_threshold 的频次过滤：counts OrderedDict LRU tracker（max_tracker_size 默认 64000）只放行出现 ≥ threshold 次的块——『确认被复用才值得搬』，但 TieringOffloadingSpec 显式拒绝 ≥2（cascade 语义要求全块）。

四态查找语义的信息论：HIT（在池且可读）/ HIT_PENDING（在池、写入在飞——计数但不阻塞扫描）/ RETRY（位置未定——不计数、触发异步查询后继续扫）/ MISS（确定不在——break）；前缀查找『MISS 之后必 MISS』沿链早停（与 ch15 链式哈希同宗）；SWA 组从尾扫连续窗口 hit 数。收敛循环：某组收紧 max_hit_size_tokens 可能让先前已确认的组结果失效→重扫（同 ch16 混合不动点思想），eagle 组多查一块后弹出（draft 尾易变）。

单请求 job 互斥不变量（scheduler.py 注释原文「at any given time this contains either a single load job, or one or more store jobs」）：load 与 store 不能同时在飞——load 的 dst GPU 块正是 store 的 src 池块语义对偶，交错会引入『半旧半新』块；配合 get_num_new_matched_tokens 开头的在飞检查（transfer_jobs 非空→None 延后）实现。

查询路径：get_num_new_matched_tokens→_lookup——full 组前缀逐块查（LookupResult 四态 match）+SWA 组从尾数连续窗口+多组收敛循环+eagle 多查一块弹出；RETRY→None『稍后再问』接 ch16 skipped；在飞 job 互斥/命中块正被加载→None 延后；命中后 touch 刷新鲜（含 GPU 命中块）

加载路径：update_state_after_alloc——命中 keys→manager.prepare_load（ref_cnt 防逐）+dst GPU 块 GPULoadStoreSpec（group_sizes/block_indices 支持 offload 块大于 GPU 块的半块对齐）→load job 过线→submit_load DMA CPU→GPU→finished_recving 接 ch16 提升（WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS→_try_promote→补缓存+全命中退一 token）

完成回收：completed_jobs {job_id:count} 逐 worker 计数、aggregate 跨 worker 求和、聚满 world_size 才 complete_store/complete_load（stale job 以 _stale_job_threshold 丢弃）；store 永不发 finished_sending；has_pending_push_work=bool(_jobs) or manager.has_pending_work() 保活引擎

flush 围栏：GPU 块将被复用（_block_id_to_pending_jobs ∩ 本步新分配块）/请求被抢占/终局前 store 未完 三触发→jobs_to_flush→worker handle_preemptions（ch16 m7 挂点）抢先提交+wait() 同步——『块复用与异步搬运竞态』的 best-effort 答案（对照 ch16 wait_for_save 每拍强制等）

分层池五原则：CPU primary 是唯一能 DMA GPU 的层；store 完成即 cascade 全层下推（prepare_read 钉 ref_cnt→tier.submit_store）；secondary 命中先 promotion（prepare_write 占位 ref_cnt=-1→RETRY→on_schedule_end 批量 submit_load）；primary 满则 promotion 失败=MISS；调度器进程经 primary.get_kv_memoryview 直读写 /dev/shm 池（secondary 的 I/O 全在调度器进程）

chunk 粒度与 OffloadKey：OffloadKey=block_hash+group_idx 打包 bytes（免去 tuple GC）；block_size/blocks_per_chunk 把 blocks_per_chunk 个 GPU 块并成一个 offload 块（CPU 页=GPU 页×blocks_per_chunk）——簿记条数 vs 查找粒度的权衡；fs 层用哈希前缀目录分桶（<hhh>/<hh>_g<group>/<hash>.bin）限扇出

P2P 层·实例间共享 CPU 池：每实例对称 peer（无固定 P/D 角色，同一实例对不同请求可 consumer 可 producer）；kv_transfer_params 三角色键（remote_prefiller/remote_decoder/remote_kv_source）由编排层（router/EPP）驱动 LookupMsg→LookupRespMsg→FetchMsg→NIXL WRITE→TransferDoneMsg 协议；P/D 模式跳过 Lookup 直接 Fetch；watchdog 收死对端缓冲

生态对照·同一契约的三种填法：MooncakeStoreConnector（MooncakeDistributedStore 分布式池：mooncake_master 元数据协调、embedded 各 rank 出内存凑池/standalone-store 外置进程持池+SSD 层、replica tier 内存/磁盘分层；lookup_async 后台 ZMQ RPC None=稍后再问；I/O 全在 get_finished 发）vs LMCacheConnectorV1（use_native 双路 lazy import：内置适配器 vs 外部包）vs MultiConnector（P/D+池化组合：查询按 connectors 列表顺序、第一个命中数>0 的子 connector 获加载权——判据 to_return[0]==0 and toks>0 只首次赋值、后续更长命中不覆盖（L399-L404 注释原话「The first connector that has new matched tokens will be assigned to this request」）；全部子 connector 都收 store）

事件面·池里有什么：OffloadingEvent（keys/medium/removed/locality）→OffloadingEventsTracker 翻译成 KV events 标准流 BlockStored/BlockRemoved——外部路由器/索引（--kv-events-config）据此把请求路由到『有这块的引擎』；self_describing 模式带 token_ids/块哈希/组元数据；fs/obj 层可自带 medium 标记（FS/OBJ）
请求级旋钮：max_offload_tokens（只卸前 N token——已知前缀值得缓存、请求特有尾部不值得，实验性）与 kv_load_tiers（TierFilter：per-request 按 medium/locality 限定参与的层）——ch37 回执信封 kv_transfer_params 的池化用法
